item.title: Sail the Med in style: New Excess catamarans available for charter
item.description: As the summer season approaches, Mediterranean sailing beckons with its crystal-clear waters, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage. What better way to experience the Med than on a brand-new Excess Catamaran, perfectly designed for a sailing vacation of a lifetime? We have sparkling new fresh-from-the-factory Excess Catamarans arriving, and we’re excited to offer them for charter in some of the most amazing destinations in the Mediterranean, including Montenegro, the French Riviera, and Croatia. Get to know Excess sailing catamarans These sleek and stylish Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are just a few of the latest exciting additions to our Dream Yacht fleet, and they’re packed with features that make them perfect for sailors and those looking to explore the best of the Mediterranean from aboard a new, thoughtfully-designed Excess charter yacht. If you haven’t sailed aboard an Excess Catamaran before, you’re in for a treat. Excess yachts place a special design emphasis on a satisfying sailing experience, with exceptional responsiveness at the helm and heightened sailing “sensations”. Excess achieves an excellent level of onboard comfort as well – but not at the expense of performance. Meet the Excess 14 & Excess 11 The recently released Excess 14 is gaining momentum with sailing enthusiasts for its substantial 46-ft length offering uniquely nimble handling, reduced drag and improved stability. The Dream Yacht charter version features 4-cabins and 4-baths with plenty of space for a larger group of Mediterranean adventurers. The smaller Excess 11 is 37-ft of sailing fun. It’s perfect for small groups and families to explore the Mediterranean, with 4 comfortable cabins and 2 baths. For those newer to sailing it’s designed for ease of sailing, with excellent visibility and self-tacking jib. More experienced sailors will appreciate the lively helm and thrilling sailing sensations. Both models feature the latest technology and innovations from Excess, including a sleek and modern design, a large cockpit with a sliding glass door, and a spacious salon with plenty of natural light. They are also equipped with a range of amenities, including air conditioning, generator, and watermaker, ensuring a comfortable and convenient sailing experience. Whether you’re an experienced sailor or just starting out, the Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are sure to impress. Their combination of performance, comfort, and style makes them the perfect choice for a Med charter vacation. The new Excess 13 In addition to the Excess 11 and 14, Excess has announced that their newest catamaran offering will be announced at the upcoming La Grand Motte boat show this spring. The exciting new Excess 13 is a sleek, dependable and lively sailboat – a perfect charter vacation platform. Watch for arrivals into the Dream Yacht Charter fleet soon! Charter a New Excess 14 – Trogir, Croatia Trogir, located on the Dalmatian coast of Croatia, is a historic town surrounded by a stunning archipelago, with countless islands, bays, and beaches to explore – the perfect starting point for your Croatia sailing charter . Trogir is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with a rich history dating back to the ancient Greeks and Romans. The town’s narrow streets and picturesque piazzas are filled with historic landmarks, including the stunning Trogir Cathedral and the Kamerlengo Fortress. The surrounding islands, such as the famed Hvar and Brač, offer a range of sailing opportunities, from secluded beaches to vibrant ports and harbors. Our new Excess 14 catamaran is available for charters from our base in Trogir, Croatia beginning June 14, 2025 offering the perfect opportunity to experience the best of Croatia’s sailing scene. Plan now and grab your chance at summer sailing aboard this brand new Dream Yacht “Super Premiere” sailing catamaran. item.title: How to Decide Whether a Catamaran or Monohull Is Right for Your Sailing Vacation
item.description: As the world’s leading yacht charter company, we have a diverse fleet with more than 1,000 yachts, including the latest cutting-edge models from the world’s best manufacturers of catamarans and monohulls. When it comes to planning your bareboat yacht charter or skippered sailing vacation, choosing your perfect yacht can be the hardest challenge. The difference between catamarans and monohulls really comes down to personal preference. Our expert team is on hand to help you choose the best boat for your sailing vacation. Enjoy the comfort of a catamaran or take on a true sailing experience with a monohull, we’ve got some advice below on the advantages of both… The benefits of catamaran sailing vacations Entertainment : If you are chartering with a large group of friends or family, a catamaran is the perfect floating hotel. They offer plenty of communal areas to get together. Comfort: The superior stability of catamarans make them perfect for families sailing with young children and more enjoyable for guests who need to get used to their sea legs. The thoughtfully designed cabins offer modern comfort after a long day of exploring on and offshore. Space: Catamarans have plenty of deck space for sunbathing, privacy for mid-afternoon naps and ample room for lounging or group dining. Our catamarans range in size from 38ft to 52ft – sail yourself or hire one of our skippers to sail it for you. Watersports: Catamarans have the extra space for water toys and sporting equipment, such as kayaks, paddleboards, water skis and inflatables. Exploring from the beach : Catamarans have a shallow draught and are able to get close to the beaches. Sometimes you can literally step off the boat and onto the beach, making it easier to go ashore without the dinghy or water taxis. To get a feel of the atmosphere on board one of our catamarans, read our interview with the crew of CruiseNautic , which is available with a crew for private hire. Hear what one of our customers had to say about her French Polynesia vacation aboard a crewed catamaran . Take a look at our all-inclusive crewed yacht charters and organized by the cabin sailing vacations. The advantages of monohulls A true sailing experience: A monohull is an ideal option for anyone who wants to have the classic sailing adventure, whether they are a sailor or not. If you are an accomplished boater, take the helm yourself and if you aren’t, then you can hire a skipper to do the sailing for you. Adrenaline lover’s choice : Our monohulls deliver sailing that is fast and exhilarating. These boats give you optimal control, whether the conditions are flat and calm, or rough and wild. It’s a wonderful option for those who love the sporting aspect of sailing. Manoeuvrability: Monohulls can make sharper turns and navigate easily through narrow channels and tight spaces. Couples or individuals with sailing experience and who are seeking the thrill of the sail need look no further. Couples and smaller groups: Our well-maintained monohulls offer every creature comfort for those looking for a real sailing adventure and feeling the lean into the wind. Learn more To choose the perfect yacht for your next sailing vacation, contact our team for more information. Email us at [email protected] or give us a call at 855.650.8902.
